17. DEFERRED TAX ASSET
(i) The net deferred tax asset is attributable to the following:

Accelerated depreciation
Unrealised exchange differences
General provisions
Net deferred tax asset

(ii) Movement on the deferred tax account is as follows:
At 1 January
Tax credit recognized in profit or loss (Note 9 (i))
At 31 December

Deferred taxation is estimated on all temporary differences under the liability method using the currently enacted
tax rate of 30% (2010 - 30%).

Refined products
Raw material and crude oil
Consumables and accessories
Provision for obsolete and defective stocks
